episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'separation season' and how agents can leverage the last quarter of the year to set themselves apart. He emphasizes the importance of sticking to fundamentals and maintaining a strong mindset during slower periods. The episode also covers practical strategies for lead generation and client retention, offering insights for both individual agents and team leaders.
